source.purpose: ONT min/max create payload templates and invalid parameter matrix. Runtime target SN/password are injected by tests.

observed.note: IP host static fields, servicelist, tcontlist, dspir, fdbmaclist, wifi24glist, wifi5glist, wanlist, voiplist, and firmware config fields passed CLI-first, REST Success, and CLI verification on NODE3 3-16-1. static_mask uses dotted netmask because live CLI rejected prefix length 24. templatename passed official ONT max live verification after creating the NeoX ONTTemplateProfile dependency. Firmware fields are config-only checks and use mode never.
observed.max_dynamic_note: max_dynamic covers dynamic_vid and dynamic_pbit as an official max variant without mixing mutually exclusive static and dynamic IP-host modes or unrelated high-dependency max fields in one payload.

max_dynamic.note: Official max coverage variant for dynamic IP-host mode. It intentionally excludes static IP-host, service/tcont, template, firmware, FDB, WiFi, WAN, and VoIP fields because those are covered by max_static and some are not stable when mixed with dynamic IP-host in the same REST payload.
